title: World's heaviest blueberry
summary: Costa reports that a blueberry of the Eterna variety picked at its Corindi farm on 13 November 2023 was recognised as the world's heaviest, at 20.40 g and 39.31 mm, beating a previous record of 16.20 g set in Western Australia in 2020. The berry is credited to Brad Hocking, Jessica Scalzo and Marie-France Courtois. The release also describes the Variety Improvement Program as operating for more than 25 years and states that Costa is both the breeder and the grower.
why_it_matters: A single adjudicated fruit is a genuine measurement, unlike most owner claims in this dataset, but it is a record specimen and says nothing about the cultivar's mean fruit size. The distinction matters because record-berry publicity is routinely read as a varietal performance claim.

reading.rationale: A measured datum with a date, site and adjudicating body.

testing.rationale: Interesting as a genetic size ceiling, not as an expected size.

commercial_position.rationale: Strong marketing asset for a competing platform.
